prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one finished full-bleed 3:2 landscape illustration for a heartfelt birthday letter about future travel dreams. A lovingly arranged still life on a warm worn wooden table: a beautiful compact mirrorless camera with a tactile black grip and silver top, with its fabric camera strap casually curved; two distinct illustrated travel postcards lying beside and partly behind it. One postcard clearly depicts Banff: a luminous turquoise alpine lake surrounded by dark evergreen trees and dramatic snowy Canadian Rocky Mountain peaks. The other postcard clearly depicts Vietnam: a lantern-lit riverside old town street, ochre buildings, colorful silk lanterns and little boats on a glowing river. A tiny red heart-shaped charm with two small ivory horns rests beside the camera, an affectionate private motif. Warm low golden sunlight crosses the table, soft rich teal shadows, hints of coral. Cohesive anime/gouache graphic-novel artwork, textured cel shading, fine confident ink contours, tactile brush texture, cinematic composition, detailed but tender and quiet. The camera and both postcards are easy to see at a glance. No people, no characters, no text, no typography, no logos, no brand names, no UI, no panel borders. The postcards contain only pictures, no lettering.
